content: <@353899706172178433> sorry to revive an old thread but curious -- about how many accounts do you run per influencer to get that kind of follower growth? (assuming each account runs for about 2 hrs /day)
Yes, we are going to sell the dashboard. It will require a one-time setup fee and yearly license. It will take some time until it is finished.
Will you make a white label version for people like us that run their own farm?

We offer a Followers growth service to clients (not OF-related), including local businesses, influencers, and others. We offer 300-500 follower growth per month. Pricing depends on whether we work with a direct client, an agency (which has multiple clients), or a large agency that is offering a white-label version of our service. We charge between $30 and $99 per month per client.

We are running F/UNF and post likes, and have access to a client account. We have a team that monitors the growth of clients and takes care of customer service. It's great business, especially if you are running it locally in your native language.

We are currently finalizing the web app dashboard, which is connected to our bot and features a Client area, Manager, and Admin.
